---
title: "View iSamples Parquet"
---

```{ojs}
// Import Observable's libraries
import {DuckDBClient} from "@observablehq/duckdb"

// Create a DuckDB instance
db = DuckDBClient.of()

// Set the Parquet file path
parquet_path = 'https://storage.googleapis.com/opencontext-parquet/oc_isamples_pqg.parquet'


async function loadData(query, params=[], waiting_id=null) {
    // Get loading indicator
    const waiter = document.getElementById(waiting_id);
    if (waiter) {
        waiter.hidden = false;
    }
    try {
        // Run the (slow) query
        const _results = await db.query(query, ...params);
        return _results;
    } catch (error) {
        if (waiter) {
            waiter.innerHtml = `<pre>${error}</pre>`;
        }
        return null;
    } finally {
        // Hide the waiter (if there is one)
        if (waiter) {
            waiter.hidden = true;
        }
    }
}

{
    const query = `SELECT pid, latitude, longitude FROM read_parquet('${parquet_path}') WHERE otype='GeospatialCoordLocation'`;
    return Inputs.table(loadData(query, [], "loading_1"));
}
```

<div id="loading_1">Loading...</div>



```{ojs}
// Query the Parquet file
records = loadData(`SELECT COUNT(*) as count, otype FROM read_parquet('${parquet_path}') GROUP BY otype ORDER BY count DESC`, [], "loading_2")
viewof results = Inputs.table(records);
```
